spots.name: Jaro Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral, also known as the National Shrine of the Our Lady of Candles, Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Elizabeth of Hungary, and colloquially as Jaro Cathedral, is a cathedral and national shrine located in the district of Jaro in Iloilo City, on the island of Panay in the Philippines.

spots.name: Molo Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Santa Ana Parish Church, commonly known as Molo Church, is a Spanish neo-Gothic Roman Catholic church located in the district of Molo in Iloilo City, in the Philippines. It is under the jurisdiction of the Archdiocese of Jaro.

spots.name: Sunburst Park
spots.summary: Sunburst Park, originally known as Plaza de Aduana, is a recreational park situated in front of the Iloilo Customs House on Calle Real in downtown Iloilo City, Philippines.

spots.name: Jaro Belfry

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Jaro Belfry, also known as Campanario de Jaro, is a Baroque and neoclassical free-standing bell tower located in front of the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral in Jaro, Iloilo City, Philippines.

spots.name: Calle Real, Iloilo
spots.summary: Calle Real, officially named as J.M. Basa Street, is a historic street located in the old downtown district of Iloilo City Proper in Iloilo City, Philippines. It is home to several fine examples of luxury American-era neoclassical, beaux-arts, and art deco buildings.

spots.name: Iloilo River Esplanade
spots.summary: The Iloilo River Esplanade is a 9.29-kilometre-long (5.77 mi) urban esplanade and linear park along the Iloilo River in Iloilo City, Philippines. It stretches on both sides of the river, from Carpenter Bridge in Mandurriao and Molo districts to Drilon Bridge in the City Proper and Lapuz districts.

spots.name: Plaza Libertad
spots.summary: Plaza Libertad, formerly known as Plaza Alfonso XII, is a historic plaza or town square in Iloilo City, Philippines.

spots.name: Camiña Balay Nga Bato

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Avanceña–Camiña Balay Nga Bato, also known simply as Camiña Balay Nga Bato, is a 161-year-old bahay na bato in the Arevalo district, Iloilo City, Philippines. It was built in 1865 and was designed by the first parish priest of Molo, Anselmo Avanceña, for Don Fernando Avanceña and his wife, Eulalia Abaja.

spots.name: Jaro Plaza
spots.summary: Graciano Lopez Jaena Park, also known as Jaro Plaza or Plaza Jaro in Spanish or local, is an urban park and town square located in the district of Jaro in Iloilo City, Panay Island, Philippines.

spots.name: Lopez Heritage House
spots.summary: The Lopez Heritage House, also known as Mansion de Lopez or Lopez Mansion, is a heritage house in Jaro, Iloilo City, Philippines. It was built in 1928 by Ilonggo statesman Don Vicente López and his wife, Doña Elena Hofileña, among the early members of the prominent López family of Iloilo.

spots.name: Museum of Philippine Economic History

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Museum of Philippine Economic History is a museum in Iloilo City, Philippines. It is located on the historic street of Calle Real in Iloilo City Proper.

spots.name: Muelle Loney Street
spots.summary: Muelle Loney Marginal Wharf Road, also known as Muelle Loney Street, is a street and wharf located in the Iloilo City Proper district of Iloilo City, Philippines. It runs along the south bank of the Iloilo River, stretching from the Muelle Loney (Rizal) Bridge to Fort San Pedro Drive.

spots.name: San Jose Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: San Jose Placer Parish Church, is a Roman Catholic church in Iloilo City, Philippines. It is under the jurisdiction of the Archdiocese of Jaro. It was built in 1607 by the Jesuits and is considered the first ever church in the city of Iloilo.

spots.name: Casa Real de Iloilo
spots.summary: The Casa Real de Iloilo, also known as the Old Iloilo Provincial Capitol, was the seat of the provincial government of Iloilo in the Philippines since the Spanish colonial period until 2006.

spots.name: Molo Plaza
spots.summary: Molo Plaza is an urban park and town square located in the district of Molo in Iloilo City, Philippines. It is one of the six district plazas in Iloilo City.

spots.name: Lizares Mansion
spots.summary: The Lizares–Gamboa Mansion, also known as Lizares Mansion or Villa Lizares, is a Beaux-Arts heritage house located in the district of Jaro in Iloilo City, Philippines. Built in 1937, it now serves as the chapel of Angelicum School Iloilo.

spots.name: Museo Iloilo

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Museo Iloilo is a provincial museum located near the Iloilo Provincial Capitol in Iloilo City, Philippines. It is the first government-sponsored museum in the Philippines outside of Metro Manila. The museum houses a collection of Iloilo's cultural heritage.

spots.name: Iloilo Central Business District
spots.summary: The Iloilo City Central Business District, commonly known as the Calle Real Heritage Zone and colloquially as Old Downtown Iloilo, is a historic commercial district located within the larger district of City Proper in Iloilo City, Philippines.

spots.name: Arroyo Fountain
spots.summary: Arroyo Fountain is a historic monument located in front of Casa Real de Iloilo in Iloilo City Proper, Philippines. The fountain serves as kilometre zero, the benchmark used to measure distances from Iloilo City to other points in Panay Island, the Western Visayas region, and other places in the Philippines.

spots.name: Iloilo Museum of Contemporary Art

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Iloilo Museum of Contemporary Art (ILOMOCA) is an art museum in Iloilo City, Philippines. It is the first museum in the Visayas and Mindanao dedicated to modern art.

spots.name: Mandurriao Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Espousal of Our Lady Parish Church, commonly known as Mandurriao Church, is a Roman Catholic church located in the district of Mandurriao in Iloilo City, Philippines. It is under the Archdiocese of Jaro.

spots.name: Quirino–Lopez Bridge
spots.summary: The Quirino–Lopez Bridge is a girder bridge that crosses the Iloilo River in Iloilo City, Philippines. It connects the districts of City Proper and Lapuz. Completed in 1967, the bridge spans a southbound canal historically used for sugar transport.

spots.name: Vertex Bouldering Iloilo
spots.summary: The first indoor climbing gym in Iloilo City, it offers a challenging yet beginner-friendly space for those who want to experience the thrill of wall climbing. It’s a great place to train, exercise, and meet fellow climbing enthusiasts.

spots.name: Deca Wakeboard Park
spots.summary: It offers an exciting wakeboarding experience for both beginners and pros. It’s situated just outside Iloilo City but remains easily accessible by public and private transport. The park also provides training sessions and a relaxing area for spectators.

spots.name: Bourbon Street Bar and Grill
spots.summary: A stylish bar and restaurant offering American-Filipino fusion dishes, craft cocktails, and a cozy ambiance. Their Festive Walk branch is particularly appealing, featuring a balcony dining area with views of the bustling street.

spots.name: Muelle Deli and Restaurant
spots.summary: Known for its selection of steaks, pastas, and deli items, this restaurant offers a contemporary dining experience with a view of the Iloilo River.

spots.name: Waterfront Seafood & Cocktails
spots.summary: Combines fresh seafood with a lively, modern dining atmosphere, perfect for groups and nightlife vibes, with access to the Iloilo River Esplanade.

spots.name: Drink SLS
spots.summary: A chic lounge with stylish interiors, curated cocktails, and a lively atmosphere. It's a go-to spot for those seeking a sophisticated night out.

spots.name: Bavaria German Restaurant & Inn
spots.summary: A popular spot for families and gatherings, this restaurant serves authentic German flavors, including dishes like sausages and schnitzels.

spots.name: Troi Oi
spots.summary: An authentic Vietnamese restaurant featuring traditional dishes in a setting adorned with Vietnamese-made furniture and lacquerware.

spots.name: Spring Palace Seafood Restaurant
spots.summary: Serves traditional Ilonggo-style seafood and features a temperature-controlled live seafood aquarium—the only one of its kind.

spots.name: Griller's Oyster House
spots.summary: Specializes in grilled talaba and other shellfish, cooked to order—steamed, baked, in hot chili, crispy fried, or sizzling.

spots.name: The Mango Tree Restaurant
spots.summary: A garden-themed restaurant offering a serene dining experience with a menu featuring Filipino and international dishes.

spots.name: MO2 Ice Bar
spots.summary: A vibrant place for karaoke, billiards, dancing, drinks, and food, catering to both small groups and families.

spots.name: Ponsyon by Breakthrough
spots.summary: Offers a more modern take on traditional Ilonggo seafood dishes, including sizzling prawns and crab platters.

spots.name: Barrio Inasal
spots.summary: A local favorite offering juicy chicken inasal and other Filipino dishes like sisig and sinigang na pompano.

spots.name: Monkey Grounds Coffee
spots.summary: A hip café with a jungle-themed interior, serving specialty coffee and light bites in a relaxed setting.

spots.name: Bluejay Coffee & Co.
spots.summary: A contemporary café known for its specialty coffee, minimalist design, and a selection of baked goods.

spots.name: The Cave Superclub And Music Hall
spots.summary: A premier nightlife destination offering live music performances and a dynamic clubbing experience.

spots.name: The Granary
spots.summary: All-day dining restaurant offers a blend of Ilonggo and international cuisines in a modern setting.

spots.name: Punot Restaurant
spots.summary: Local favorite serving affordable seafood platters alongside modernized Ilonggo dishes.

spots.name: Samurai Talabahan Seafood Restaurant
spots.summary: Known for fresh oysters and a variety of oyster dishes with Japanese-inspired sauces.

spots.name: JLK Music Bar
spots.summary: Known for its lively atmosphere, neon lights, and a wide selection of drinks.

spots.name: Glory's Café
spots.summary: A traditional brewed coffee since 1948, now run by its third generation.
